# Side nav: `jl-side-nav`

The navigation down the side of an app, with nested items and a collapsed rail.

- Class `JlSideNav`, a organism: `import { JlSideNav } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/side-nav

The navigation down the side of an app: sections under small headings, items with an icon and a badge,
and items with children that open with a chevron. value is the active item: it is drawn in the accent colour, and
the parents above it open to show it.

collapsed turns it into a rail of icons, for when the content needs the room: the labels become tooltips (and stay
for screen readers), badges become dots, and a parent leads to its first child. collapsible lets people do it: its
edge becomes a handle, a short grip that lights the whole edge under the pointer, and a press on it folds the side nav
into its rail or unfolds it; so do the keys of hotkey (Ctrl+B, ⌘B on a Mac), from anywhere in the page. collapse says
so for the app to remember it on the device. In the drawer of a narrow jl-app-shell, the side nav shows whole, without
the handle or the keys. While it shows
as a rail, the host carries the rail attribute, for styles around it: jl-side-nav[rail].

Every item is a link (with an href) or a button, so the Tab key reaches it; Up and Down move between the visible
items, Right opens a parent and Left closes it. Items without an href fire select; put the side nav in the nav slot
of jl-app-shell for the whole frame. A list longer than the nav scrolls between the header slot and the bottom, which
stay in place.

## Use

```ts
import { JlSideNav } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlSideNav
  sections={[{"items":[{"icon":"house","id":"home","label":"Home"},{"badge":12,"icon":"inbox","id":"inbox","label":"Inbox"},{"icon":"bell","id":"activity","label":"Activity"}]},{"items":[{"children":[{"id":"website","label":"Website"},{"badge":"New","id":"mobile-app","label":"Mobile app"},{"id":"design-system","label":"Design system and its documentation site"}],"icon":"folder","id":"projects","label":"Projects"},{"icon":"chart","id":"reports","label":"Reports"},{"icon":"users","id":"team","label":"Team"}],"label":"Workspace"},{"items":[{"icon":"settings","id":"settings","label":"Settings"},{"icon":"credit-card","id":"billing","label":"Billing"}],"label":"Account"}]}
  value="website"
/>
```

```html
<jl-side-nav
  sections='[{"items":[{"icon":"house","id":"home","label":"Home"},{"badge":12,"icon":"inbox","id":"inbox","label":"Inbox"},{"icon":"bell","id":"activity","label":"Activity"}]},{"items":[{"children":[{"id":"website","label":"Website"},{"badge":"New","id":"mobile-app","label":"Mobile app"},{"id":"design-system","label":"Design system and its documentation site"}],"icon":"folder","id":"projects","label":"Projects"},{"icon":"chart","id":"reports","label":"Reports"},{"icon":"users","id":"team","label":"Team"}],"label":"Workspace"},{"items":[{"icon":"settings","id":"settings","label":"Settings"},{"icon":"credit-card","id":"billing","label":"Billing"}],"label":"Account"}]'
  value="website"
></jl-side-nav>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `sections` (attribute `sections`): `SideNavSection<Id>[]`, default `[]`. The sections: an optional label, and items with id, label, icon, href (and target: _blank for a new tab), badge and children.
- `value` (attribute `value`): `Id | ''`, default `''`. The id of the active item.
- `collapsed` (attribute `collapsed`): `boolean`, default `false`. A narrow rail of icons, with the labels as tooltips.
- `collapsible` (attribute `collapsible`): `boolean`, default `false`. Makes its edge a handle that folds the side nav into its rail and unfolds it, as the hotkey does.
- `collapseLabel` (attribute `collapse-label`): `string`, default `''`. What the handle says (its hint, and to screen readers) while the side nav is open. Empty: jlib's own text, in the language shown.
- `expandLabel` (attribute `expand-label`): `string`, default `''`. What it says while the side nav is a rail. Empty: jlib's own text, in the language shown.
- `hotkey` (attribute `hotkey`): `string`, default `'mod+b'`. The keys that fold and unfold a collapsible side nav from anywhere in the page: mod is ⌘ on a Mac and Ctrl elsewhere. none for no keys. Of several collapsible side navs in a page, the first takes the press.
- `inDrawer` (attribute `in-drawer`): `boolean`, default `false`. Set by jl-app-shell while the side nav is its drawer: it shows whole there, and its fold button hides.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The name of the navigation for screen readers. Empty: jlib's own text, in the language shown.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `select` (`onSelect` in JSX), detail `Id`: An item was chosen: its id.
- `collapse` (`onCollapse` in JSX), detail `boolean`: People folded the side nav into its rail (true) or unfolded it (false), with its handle or its keys.

## Slots

- `header`: Above the sections, and stays there while they scroll: a brand, a workspace switcher.
- `footer`: At the bottom, and stays there while the sections scroll: the account, a help link.

## Methods

- `toggleItem(id: string, force?: boolean): void`: Opens or closes a parent item; force sets the state instead of flipping it.

## Styling

- `--width` (custom property): The width when expanded (248px).
- `--rail-width` (custom property): The width of the rail (60px).
- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The nav element inside.

## Typing

Typed by its ids, JlSideNav<'jobs' | 'people' | 'teams' | 'settings'> takes items of those ids only, nested ones included, and gives select and value as one of them: the editor completes them and refuses another.

```ts
import type { JlSideNav } from '@syware/jlib';

type Place = 'jobs' | 'people' | 'teams' | 'settings';

const nav = document.querySelector<JlSideNav<Place>>('jl-side-nav');
nav?.sections.set([
  {
    items: [
      { icon: 'briefcase', id: 'jobs', label: 'Jobs' },
      { children: [{ id: 'teams', label: 'Teams' }], icon: 'users', id: 'people', label: 'People' },
    ],
  },
  { items: [{ icon: 'settings', id: 'settings', label: 'Settings' }], label: 'Account' },
]);
// @ts-expect-error: 'billing' is not a place of the navigation
nav?.value.set('billing');
nav?.events.register('select', (place) => goTo(place)); // place: Place, nested ones included
```

```tsx
import { Jadis } from '@jadis/core';
import { JlSideNav } from '@syware/jlib';

import type { SideNavSection } from '@syware/jlib';

type Place = 'jobs' | 'people' | 'teams' | 'settings';

const SECTIONS: SideNavSection<Place>[] = [
  {
    items: [
      { icon: 'briefcase', id: 'jobs', label: 'Jobs' },
      { children: [{ id: 'teams', label: 'Teams' }], icon: 'users', id: 'people', label: 'People' },
    ],
  },
  { items: [{ icon: 'settings', id: 'settings', label: 'Settings' }], label: 'Account' },
];

export class AppNav extends Jadis {
  static readonly selector = 'app-nav';

  templateHtml(): Node {
    // value="billing" does not compile.
    return (
      <JlSideNav<Place>
        slot="nav"
        sections={SECTIONS}
        value="jobs"
        collapsible
        onSelect={(place) => goTo(place)}
      />
    );
  }
}

AppNav.register();
```

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Sections and nesting

Badges, a nested group, and the active item inside it; a label too long for the nav ends in “…”.

```html
<div style="height: 540px; border: 1px solid var(--jl-line); border-radius: var(--jl-radius-lg); width: 260px">
  <jl-side-nav value="mobile-app" sections='[{"items":[{"icon":"house","id":"home","label":"Home"},{"badge":12,"icon":"inbox","id":"inbox","label":"Inbox"},{"icon":"bell","id":"activity","label":"Activity"}]},{"items":[{"children":[{"id":"website","label":"Website"},{"badge":"New","id":"mobile-app","label":"Mobile app"},{"id":"design-system","label":"Design system and its documentation site"}],"icon":"folder","id":"projects","label":"Projects"},{"icon":"chart","id":"reports","label":"Reports"},{"icon":"users","id":"team","label":"Team"}],"label":"Workspace"},{"items":[{"icon":"settings","id":"settings","label":"Settings"},{"icon":"credit-card","id":"billing","label":"Billing"}],"label":"Account"}]'></jl-side-nav>
</div>
```

### Collapsed rail

collapsible: a press on the handle at its edge, or Ctrl+B, folds it into a rail of icons (hover one for its label), and unfolds it.

```html
<div style="height: 540px; border: 1px solid var(--jl-line); border-radius: var(--jl-radius-lg)">
  <jl-side-nav collapsible collapsed value="inbox" sections='[{"items":[{"icon":"house","id":"home","label":"Home"},{"badge":12,"icon":"inbox","id":"inbox","label":"Inbox"},{"icon":"bell","id":"activity","label":"Activity"}]},{"items":[{"children":[{"id":"website","label":"Website"},{"badge":"New","id":"mobile-app","label":"Mobile app"},{"id":"design-system","label":"Design system and its documentation site"}],"icon":"folder","id":"projects","label":"Projects"},{"icon":"chart","id":"reports","label":"Reports"},{"icon":"users","id":"team","label":"Team"}],"label":"Workspace"},{"items":[{"icon":"settings","id":"settings","label":"Settings"},{"icon":"credit-card","id":"billing","label":"Billing"}],"label":"Account"}]'></jl-side-nav>
</div>
```

### Header, footer and listening

A brand in the header slot, the account in the footer slot; the sentence listens to select.

```html
<div class="row" style="align-items: start">
  <div style="height: 540px; border: 1px solid var(--jl-line); border-radius: var(--jl-radius-lg); width: 260px">
    <jl-side-nav class="demo-select" value="home" sections='[{"items":[{"icon":"house","id":"home","label":"Home"},{"badge":12,"icon":"inbox","id":"inbox","label":"Inbox"},{"icon":"bell","id":"activity","label":"Activity"}]},{"items":[{"children":[{"id":"website","label":"Website"},{"badge":"New","id":"mobile-app","label":"Mobile app"},{"id":"design-system","label":"Design system and its documentation site"}],"icon":"folder","id":"projects","label":"Projects"},{"icon":"chart","id":"reports","label":"Reports"},{"icon":"users","id":"team","label":"Team"}],"label":"Workspace"},{"items":[{"icon":"settings","id":"settings","label":"Settings"},{"icon":"credit-card","id":"billing","label":"Billing"}],"label":"Account"}]'>
      <div slot="header" class="row" style="gap: 8px; padding: 4px 10px 8px; font-weight: 700">
        <jl-icon name="rocket" size="18"></jl-icon> Launchpad
      </div>
      <div slot="footer" class="row" style="gap: 8px; padding: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--jl-line)">
        <jl-icon name="user" size="16"></jl-icon>
        <span class="muted">ada@example.com</span>
      </div>
    </jl-side-nav>
  </div>
  <p class="muted demo-select-out">On home.</p>
</div>
```

```js
const nav = root.querySelector('.demo-select');
const out = root.querySelector('.demo-select-out');
nav.events.register('select', (id) => {
  out.textContent = `On ${id}.`;
});
```
